— the studio

A house of seven hands, one standard.

"We don't pick a style. We master them all — then we draw the one that fits the skin in front of us."

Mark Needle Tattoo brings together seven resident artists, each a specialist in their own corner of the craft — fine line, realism, traditional Japanese, blackwork, Thai sacred work, color, and old-school Americana. What we share is the standard: every needle is new in the box, every surface is sterilized between guests, and every consultation is free.

Located in the heart of Chiang Mai's old quarter, the studio is open daily into the night for guests on their own schedule — locals, travelers, returning collectors.

— since 2009, in ink we trust.

03 — reservations

Book Your Session

Tell us your vision. Pick your style and your artist. We'll respond within 24 hours with availability and a free design consultation.

Our three-step process

  1. 01

    Consult

    Free in-studio or video chat. We listen to your idea, discuss style, placement, and pricing — no pressure, no commitment.

  2. 02

    Design

    Your matched artist drafts a custom piece. We refine it together until every line feels right. Deposit secures your session date.

  3. 03

    Create

    The session itself. Sterile setup, fresh needles in front of you, single-use ink caps — and the kind of focus your skin deserves.

* We typically reply within 24 hours, often the same evening. For urgent inquiries call 097-954-4886.
